title: The Heretic's Trial
text: A court in session: robed judges in masks, a jeering crowd, and in the dock a woman in chains who says she is innocent, over and over, in a voice gone hoarse. The pyre is already built outside. The judges turn to the party, and ask you for a verdict.

options.label: Find her innocent, and pray she is what she says.

outcomes.text: The judges bow and unlock her chains. She was telling the truth.
The judges unlock her chains. She was lying, and she has friends.

options.label: Find her guilty. The Court has already built the pyre.

outcomes.text: In its way, the Court is pleased with you. From the road you hear the pyre, and her hoarse voice still insisting she is innocent.

options.label: The wisest cross-examines the judges, to learn what this trial truly is.

outcomes.text: It was never a trial at all. You learn a great deal about how the Court thinks.
